item.title: Tree is damaged problem, 3rd August
item.description:
It is ion the adopted Highway I am writing to request that the council considers inspecting and, if appropriate, pruning the tree situated outside my mother's property. Over time, the tree has become significantly overgrown, with branches now extending well over the boundary into my mother's front garden. As the tree has matured, it has also begun to block a considerable amount of natural light from entering her front room, leaving it noticeably darker throughout the day. Whilst I appreciate that trees provide many benefits and that maintenance has to be carefully managed, the current situation is having a real impact on my mother. She is elderly and spends a great deal of time at home. The lack of natural light, together with the overhanging branches, has become a constant source of worry for her. She has become increasingly anxious about the tree and has become quite fixated on it, which is affecting her wellbeing and enjoyment of her home. I would therefore be very grateful if the council could arrange for an inspection to assess whether the tree would benefit from pruning. I am not requesting that the tree be removed, only that it is appropriately maintained so that it no longer overhangs the property to the same extent and allows more natural light into her home.
Report on FixMyStreet

item.description:

It is very difficult to exit Undercliff Avenue without being hit by a speeding car in either direction. Many cyclists are now using Undercliff Avenue after cycling on the hill.
